articles.title: This Is Donald Trump’s AI Brain Trust
articles.raw_content: “It’s not an argument with two sides, it’s an argument with 10 sides,” one senior administration official tells WIRED about how US AI policy is being shaped.
articles.summary: La política de inteligencia artificial en EE. UU. se está definiendo con múltiples perspectivas, según un alto funcionario.

articles.title: SK Telecom launches dedicated AI infra company
articles.raw_content: SK Telecom said that SK Hyper will oversee the full development process for its AIDC business, including securing land, constructing and operating substations, attracting customers, and commercializing new facilities In…
articles.summary: SK Telecom crea SK Hyper para supervisar el desarrollo completo de su negocio AIDC, desde la adquisición de terrenos hasta la comercialización de nuevas instalaciones.

articles.title: Making sense of the panic over Chinese AI
articles.raw_content: On the latest episode of Equity, we discussed why Moonshot AI's Kimi seemed to panic Silicon Valley and Wall Street.
articles.summary: Kimi de Moonshot AI ha generado alarma en Silicon Valley y Wall Street, según se discutió en el último episodio de Equity.
